<title id="m0206-f1-zh-title">圖 1｜從網域走到網路治理</title>
<desc id="m0206-f1-zh-desc">DNS解析取得IP；前綴組成路由範圍，AS代表共同路由政策管理；服務與網路營運角色分層。</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0206-f1-zh-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="698" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">圖 1｜從網域走到網路治理</text>
<rect x="32" y="68" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="97" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">網域：learn.example</text>
<text x="300" y="124" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">DNS：查詢 A / AAAA 紀錄</text>
<text x="300" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">取得服務使用的 IPv4 / IPv6 位址</text>
<path d="M300 168V192" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0206-f1-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="196" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">IP 位址 → 網路前綴</text>
<text x="300" y="252" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">例如 192.0.2.10 → 192.0.2.0/24</text>
<text x="300" y="279" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">前綴表示一段 IP 位址範圍</text>
<path d="M300 296V320" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0206-f1-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="324" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="353" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">自治系統 AS → 自治系統編號 ASN</text>
<text x="300" y="380" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">由共同路由政策管理的網路集合</text>
<text x="300" y="407" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">比對註冊資料與路由觀測</text>
<rect x="32" y="452" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="481" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">分清服務與網路營運角色</text>
<text x="300" y="508" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">網站經營者／雲端業者／CDN 業者</text>
<text x="300" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">以資產清冊及服務設定建立關聯</text>
<text x="300" y="608" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">CDN：內容傳遞網路，提供邊緣節點服務</text>
<text x="300" y="634" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">本圖網域與 IP 為文件示例</text>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 700" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0206-f2-zh-title m0206-f2-zh-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0206-f2-zh-title">圖 2｜位址、前綴與 ASN 的層次</title>
<desc id="m0206-f2-zh-desc">IP是位址，前綴是位址範圍，ASN識別自治系統。使用文件保留位址與ASN，以及私有網路範例。</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0206-f2-zh-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="698" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">圖 2｜位址、前綴與 ASN 的層次</text>
<rect x="32" y="68" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="97" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">單一位址：192.0.2.10</text>
<text x="300" y="124" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">前綴：192.0.2.0/24</text>
<text x="300" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">/24 表示前 24 個位元是網路前綴</text>
<rect x="32" y="196" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">私有網路：10.20.0.0/24</text>
<text x="300" y="252" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">屬於私有位址範圍 10.0.0.0/8</text>
<text x="300" y="279" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">依內部資產清冊確認用途與負責人</text>
<rect x="32" y="324" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="353" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">自治系統：AS64496 與 AS64497</text>
<text x="300" y="380" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">ASN 用來識別路由管理的自治系統</text>
<text x="300" y="407" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">這兩個 ASN 保留供文件示例使用</text>
<rect x="32" y="452" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="481" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">整理成三個欄位</text>
<text x="300" y="508" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">位址 IP｜位址範圍 Prefix｜系統 ASN</text>
<text x="300" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">各欄位搭配來源、時間與觀測脈絡</text>
<text x="300" y="608" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">192.0.2.0/24 為文件保留位址</text>
<text x="300" y="634" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">本圖使用合成資料說明層次</text>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 700" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0206-f3-zh-title m0206-f3-zh-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0206-f3-zh-title">圖 3｜逐步增加 TTL 看見路徑</title>
<desc id="m0206-f3-zh-desc">IPv4 TTL隨轉送遞減；到零的路由器通常回Time Exceeded。TTL1顯示R1，TTL2顯示R2，TTL3抵達目的。</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0206-f3-zh-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="698" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">圖 3｜逐步增加 TTL 看見路徑</text>
<rect x="32" y="68" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="97" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">合成路徑：來源 → R1 → R2 → 目的</text>
<text x="300" y="124" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">TTL：IPv4 封包的存活欄位</text>
<text x="300" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">路由器每次轉送將 TTL 遞減</text>
<rect x="32" y="196" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">第一輪：TTL = 1</text>
<text x="300" y="252" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">來源 → R1：TTL 到零</text>
<text x="300" y="279" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">R1 → 來源：ICMP Time Exceeded</text>
<rect x="32" y="324" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="353" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">第二輪：TTL = 2</text>
<text x="300" y="380" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">來源 → R1 → R2：TTL 到零</text>
<text x="300" y="407" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">R2 → 來源：ICMP Time Exceeded</text>
<rect x="32" y="452" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="481" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">第三輪：TTL = 3，抵達目的</text>
<text x="300" y="508" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">目的回應依 UDP / ICMP / TCP 方法而異</text>
<text x="300" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">記錄回覆位址與來回時間 RTT</text>
<text x="300" y="608" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">IPv6 對應欄位稱為 Hop Limit</text>
<text x="300" y="634" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">實驗於合法授權的隔離環境進行</text>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 700" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0206-f4-zh-title m0206-f4-zh-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0206-f4-zh-title">圖 4｜讓觀測結果可以回查</title>
<desc id="m0206-f4-zh-desc">保留時間、觀測位置、方法與原始結果，搭配註冊和資產資料；星號表示等待期間沒有收到回應，RTT是來回時間。</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0206-f4-zh-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="698" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">圖 4｜讓觀測結果可以回查</text>
<rect x="32" y="68" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="97" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">先記錄觀測條件</text>
<text x="300" y="124" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">時間與時區｜來源位置｜目標</text>
<text x="300" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">探測方法、參數與授權範圍</text>
<path d="M300 168V192" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0206-f4-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="196" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">保留原始輸出</text>
<text x="300" y="252" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">每跳回覆位址、RTT、星號 *</text>
<text x="300" y="279" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">*：等待時間內未收到該次回應</text>
<path d="M300 296V320" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0206-f4-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="324" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="353" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">理解 RTT：來回時間</text>
<text x="300" y="380" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">來源送出 → 節點回覆 → 來源收到</text>
<text x="300" y="407" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">每個數值對應一次探測與回程</text>
<path d="M300 424V448" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0206-f4-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="452" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="481" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">交叉核對與整理</text>
<text x="300" y="508" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">官方註冊資料＋路由資料＋資產清冊</text>
<text x="300" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">列出觀察、關聯依據與待核項目</text>
<text x="300" y="608" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">RTT 用來描述整段來回觀測</text>
<text x="300" y="634" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">路徑會隨觀測位置、時間與方法改變</text>
</svg>

<title id="m0206-f1-en-title">1 | From a domain to network governance</title>
<desc id="m0206-f1-en-desc">DNS resolves IP addresses, prefixes describe address ranges, and ASes group routing policy. Service and network operators have distinct roles.</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0206-f1-en-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>

<text x="300" y="97" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Domain: learn.example</text>
<text x="300" y="124" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">DNS: query A / AAAA records</text>
<text x="300" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Find IPv4 / IPv6 service addresses</text>

<text x="300" y="252" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">192.0.2.10 → 192.0.2.0/24</text>
<text x="300" y="279" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">A prefix describes an IP address range</text>

<text x="300" y="407" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Compare registry and routing observations</text>

<text x="300" y="481" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Separate service and network roles</text>
<text x="300" y="508" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Site operator / cloud provider / CDN</text>
<text x="300" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Correlate asset records and service settings</text>
<text x="300" y="608" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">CDN: a content delivery network with edge services</text>
<text x="300" y="634" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Domains and IPs here are documentation examples</text>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 700" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0206-f2-en-title m0206-f2-en-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0206-f2-en-title">2 | Address, prefix, and ASN layers</title>
<desc id="m0206-f2-en-desc">An IP is an address, a prefix is a range, and an ASN identifies an AS. Examples use documentation resources and private addresses.</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0206-f2-en-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>

<rect x="32" y="68" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 700" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0206-f3-en-title m0206-f3-en-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0206-f3-en-title">3 | Reveal hops by increasing TTL</title>
<desc id="m0206-f3-en-desc">IPv4 TTL decreases when forwarded. A router reaching zero typically returns Time Exceeded. TTL 1 reveals R1; TTL 2 reveals R2; TTL 3 reaches the destination.</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0206-f3-en-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="698" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">3 | Reveal hops by increasing TTL</text>
<rect x="32" y="68" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="97" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Synthetic path: Source → R1 → R2 → Target</text>
<text x="300" y="124" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">TTL: IPv4 Time to Live field</text>
<text x="300" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Routers decrement TTL as they forward</text>
<rect x="32" y="196" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Round 1: TTL = 1</text>
<text x="300" y="252" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Source → R1: TTL reaches zero</text>
<text x="300" y="279" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">R1 → Source: ICMP Time Exceeded</text>
<rect x="32" y="324" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="353" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Round 2: TTL = 2</text>
<text x="300" y="380" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Source → R1 → R2: TTL reaches zero</text>
<text x="300" y="407" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">R2 → Source: ICMP Time Exceeded</text>
<rect x="32" y="452" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="481" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Round 3: TTL = 3 reaches the target</text>
<text x="300" y="508" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Target reply depends on UDP / ICMP / TCP</text>
<text x="300" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Record reply addresses and round-trip time</text>
<text x="300" y="608" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">The corresponding IPv6 field is Hop Limit</text>
<text x="300" y="634" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Run experiments in an authorized isolated lab</text>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 700" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0206-f4-en-title m0206-f4-en-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0206-f4-en-title">4 | Make observations traceable</title>
<desc id="m0206-f4-en-desc">Preserve time, vantage point, method, and original results; correlate registry and asset records. An asterisk marks no reply within the wait; RTT measures a round trip.</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0206-f4-en-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>

<text x="300" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">4 | Make observations traceable</text>
<rect x="32" y="68" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="97" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Record observation conditions</text>
<text x="300" y="124" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Time and zone | vantage point | target</text>
<text x="300" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Probe method, options, and authorized scope</text>
<path d="M300 168V192" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0206-f4-en-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="196" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Preserve the original output</text>
<text x="300" y="252" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Reply addresses, RTTs, and asterisks</text>
<text x="300" y="279" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">*: no reply received within the wait</text>
<path d="M300 296V320" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0206-f4-en-arrow)" />

<path d="M300 424V448" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0206-f4-en-arrow)" />

<text x="300" y="481" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Correlate and summarize</text>
<text x="300" y="508" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Registry + routing data + asset inventory</text>
<text x="300" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Record findings, links, and items to verify</text>
<text x="300" y="608" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">RTT describes the complete observed round trip</text>
<text x="300" y="634" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Paths vary with vantage point, time, and method</text>
